newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded but May bids up, following OTC.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded but May bids up, following OTC.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Monday morning with bids and offers well apart.
For several periods during the session, bids were not even posted in many of the contract months.
On the physical market, a trader said that prices in May were "whizzing up," with deals said to be done in the range 10.60 to 10.70 pence a therm.
This interest was reflected on the futures market, where the bid for May was higher than Friday's settlement.
In every other month, where both bids and offers were posted they straddled the previous settlement price, indicating a lack of clear direction.
Flexibility mechanism buying on at least two separate occasions over the weekend had been expected to give a stronger tone to the market on Monday.
This was borne out by the interest in front month May on the OTC market and in the higher bid/offer range on futures, but it has yet to translate to futures trade.
